data.long_meaning: Akhirul is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Akhira' meaning 'last' and 'Rul' meaning 'one'. It is believed that this name was given to the last surviving member of a clan or dynasty. The name Akhirul carries the meaning “The Last One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akhirul usually hope their child will grow to embody the last one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
